asset_role: visual-only tangent-space live-water normal; no hydraulic, collision, wet-mask, bathymetry, or raft-force authority
generation_method: project-directed generation of an orthographic Chilko River tangent-space normal with multiscale downstream shear and cross-current structure
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable PBR game texture for an Unreal Engine whitewater river material. Primary request: create a seamless square tangent-space RGB normal map for the cold, clear, high-energy Chilko River through Lava Canyon in British Columbia, at roughly 0.20 to 3 meter surface-detail scales. Subject: physically plausible irregular flow-aligned river ripples with long taut downstream current ridges, smaller cross-current interference, subtle shear eddies, occasional dimpled turbulent pockets, and non-repeating variation appropriate to a fast glacial-fed canyon river; strong enough to catch realistic specular light but not sharp ocean waves. Style/medium: production-quality tangent-space normal map, neutral flat-blue base centered near RGB 128,128,255, with red and green slope variation and blue remaining dominant. Composition/framing: orthographic top-down data texture only, fills the entire square, seamless-looking on all four edges, no single focal feature. Constraints: normal-map data only; no water color, no foam, no riverbank, no rocks, no horizon, no perspective, no baked lighting, no shadows, no highlights, no text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid regular sine bands, honeycomb cells, radial spirals, capsule streaks, repeated motifs, and obvious tiling seams.
limitations: The asset is procedural visual infill rather than measured Chilko surface photography.
Mirrored GPU addressing is required because opposite source-image borders are not byte-identical.
It may modulate only solver-owned wet geometry and cannot create hydraulic features.
In-engine visual, guide, water-VFX, and target-hardware acceptance remain required.
